newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia March trade data due on Friday-Bernama.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia March trade data due on Friday-Bernama.

text.p: Malaysia's monthly trade data for March will be released on Friday, the national Bernama news agency said on Friday.
Bernama, which disseminates the figures, did not give a time for the release of the data by the Statistics Department, but said it would be "this afternoon".
The timing of the report's release has caught the markets off-guard, as it has been typically issued in the last week of the month.
The trade balance was in surplus of 367.2 million ringgit in February against a deficit of 102.9 million in January.
